edits.old: **Probes.** Readiness answers healthy only after the worker has polled `rwb-document` once and the API has answered its health path; liveness answers healthy when the process is up and its internal loop is responsive. Neither probe reads a channel, writes to the database or commits an offset, and a failing dependency is reported as not ready, never as live-and-broken.
edits.new:
**Probes.** Readiness answers healthy only after the worker has polled `rwb-document` once and the API has answered its health path; liveness answers healthy when the process is up and its internal loop is responsive. Neither probe reads a channel, writes to the database or commits an offset, and a failing dependency is reported as not ready, never as live-and-broken.

**Screens.** This deployment has no screen. SCR-44 belongs to the app story; its empty, loading, error and no-access states are Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-P5-E1057-OPS-10).
